posts.title: Too much choice slows me down, also I'm moving
posts.description: I've been logging some days on here, and it's been a good ride. This platform's got a nice minimalist look and feel, it's intuitive, and it's not ad-ridden. But sadly I'm leaving anyway. I re-started my blogging journey for two reasons, which are only one reason if you think about it. One, I'm sick of the hold social media has on me, on all of us.
